company.name: Meridian Family Office
company.billing: Monthly retainer plus a one-off setup fee. No performance fee is charged.

tiers.name: Essential Wealth
tiers.tagline: Order in your capital: one consolidated report and a clean tax perimeter
tiers.target_client: Wealth of 5-20M EUR, one or two jurisdictions, up to five bank and brokerage accounts
tiers.price_note: A flat retainer that does not scale with portfolio size
includes: Consolidated monthly reporting across every account
Tax planning and tax return preparation for one or two jurisdictions
Bank fee control and a cost audit across the portfolio
Quarterly investment review of the portfolio
A dedicated client manager who replies within one business day

tiers.name: Private Office
tiers.tagline: A full family office without hiring your own staff
tiers.target_client: Wealth of 20-100M EUR, several jurisdictions, real estate and private equity
tiers.price_note: Above 60M EUR under advisory the retainer is agreed individually
includes: Everything in Essential Wealth
Monthly investment committee chaired by our CIO
Holding and trust structuring, coordination of external lawyers
Real estate portfolio management and rental cash flow oversight
Access to club deals: private equity, private credit and co-investments
Liquidity management and Lombard credit lines against the portfolio
Consolidated quarterly risk report with stress tests
excludes: Full tax residency relocation support (a separate project)
tiers.team: Partner plus CIO plus tax adviser plus analyst

tiers.name: Bespoke Dynasty
tiers.tagline: Multi-jurisdictional structure and handover of capital to the next generation
tiers.target_client: Wealth from 100M EUR, three or more jurisdictions, several family branches, an operating business
tiers.setup_fee_eur: from 90000, depending on the number of structures
tiers.price_note: The final quote follows a diagnostic (4-6 weeks, 25 000 EUR, credited against the setup fee)
includes: Everything in Private Office
Family governance: family constitution, family council, decision-making rules
Succession plan and a next-gen education programme
Multi-jurisdictional trusts, foundations and PPLI structures
Philanthropy: setting up and administering a foundation
M&A support for the operating business
A dedicated team with a named partner and 24/7 access
Annual independent audit of the structure
tiers.team: Managing partner plus a dedicated team of five to seven people

addons.name: Audit of an existing structure (second opinion)

discounts: Pay the retainer 12 months upfront and get an 8% discount
Upgrade from Essential Wealth to Private Office within the first year and the setup fee is credited in full
A second household in the family (a branch) gets 25% off the retainer
